scripts.docker:clean: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans --rmi all && docker volume prune -f && docker network prune -f
scripts.database:sync: dotenv run sh -c 'poetry --directory tools/sync_database run python sync.py http://minodu.chickenkiller.com:3000/v1/files/minodu_backend_backup.zip --destination=../../data/sync --user=$MYSQL_USER --password=$MYSQL_PASSWORD'
